title: dodag.py: Missing inf/nan validation for link_etx
description: Lines 85-86 and 177-178 validate `link_etx < 0` but this passes for float('inf') and float('nan'). When path_cost() is called at line 94, `round(self.link_etx * min_hop_rank_increase)` raises OverflowError for inf or ValueError for nan, crashing the DODAG state machine. If link quality estimation produces invalid values (e.g., division by zero), routing would fail.
close_reason: ParentCandidate.__post_init__ and process_dio now reject NaN/inf/negative link_etx via math.isnan/math.isinf before path_cost.
